cases.narrative:
On 9/16/2019, police found a box containing her body in a storage unit in Philadelphia. He had removed her legs so she would fit in the box, and threw them in the Susquehanna River where they were found by fishermen.

He told police they got into an argument and he punched Jacobs several times, at least once in the head. “The last time I hit her, I hit her hard. I blasted her," he’s quoted as saying. "She didn’t get back up after that.” 

He allegedly kept her body in a closet for several months before putting her in a coal bin located behind his grandmother’s home where she was for 16 years. Her body stayed there until November 2018 when the home was sold. At that point, Babcock cut Jacobs’ legs off with a hacksaw so that her body could fit in a wooden box. A fisherman discovered her legs. He was arrested after he was allegedly seen by his current girlfriend trying to dismember her mummified body in order to make it fit in a new hiding spot and she went to police. The body was found in a storage unit in Philadelphia the same day Babcock's current girlfriend spoke to police.
